We need to find a template that does retrosynthesis: target molecule is given: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need to find a template that when applied to this molecule reproduces the reaction: carboxylic acid to amide via coupling agent. So retrosynthetic step: break amide bond to give carboxylic acid and amine. The template likely corresponds to amide formation (forward) i.e., carboxylic acid + amine -> amide. In retrosynthesis, we break amide to carboxylic acid and amine.

We need to search template catalog by criteria: functional_groups_broken: aliphatic carboxylic acid? Wait forward reaction: carboxylic acid is broken? Actually forward: carboxylic acid is transformed to amide, so the carboxylic acid functional group is broken (C-O) and amide formed (C-N). So in forward reaction, broken functional group: aliphatic carboxylic acid. Formed: amide. So we can search with functional_groups_broken = "aliphatic carboxylic acid", functional_groups_formed = "amide". Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria.
